facts.event: Elise 借口在房中默想晨祷，实则趴到窗台上探身观看夏日比武大会，尽管教团禁止女子观看。
facts.anchor: Women were not supposed to watch. It was a sin of the eyes and the body

facts.event: Conrin（二十一岁）率银灰色「灰卫队」打着灰底折翼天鹅旗入场，争夺与国王单独受冕的时刻。
facts.relation: Conrin 是 Elise 的长兄、Gaisa 与 Egil 的兄长；国王 Liran 是他们的父亲
facts.anchor: At twenty-one, he led his selected host onto the field all in shades of silver: the grey guard.

facts.event: Egil（十四岁）第三次参加混战，举黄底升翼天鹅旗独立成队，铠甲上还留着上次与兄长冲撞后锤平的凹痕。
facts.relation: Egil 是 Elise 的弟弟，Gaisa 的弟弟
facts.anchor: Egil, however, just now old enough to ride in the joust at fourteen, had his own troupe. It was his third melee

facts.event: Egil 佯装败退，引得 Conrin 全队压上，随即与另一支 Cynghal 贵族队夹击，从侧翼劈开灰卫队阵型。
facts.relation: Egil 与 Conrin、Gaisa 是亲兄弟，却在场上联手外人算计兄长
facts.anchor: Egil’s retreat had been false; knowing his brothers would run him down first

facts.event: Conrin 被逼急后勒马人立（违规动作），马匹失控撞穿旗杆围栏冲进人群，他只得弃马滚落。
facts.relation: Conrin 是 Elise 的兄长；她隔窗看出他已从「虔诚的 Conrin」变成「狠毒的 Conrin」
facts.anchor: Conrin kicked his horse up into rearing, an illegal move

facts.event: Isen 把 Elise 从窗台上生生拖回屋内，脸色惨白，以为她想跳窗自尽。
facts.relation: Isen 是 Elise 的二哥、她最喜爱的兄长；兄妹以「hyem」互称
facts.anchor: She heard a step on the reeds behind her, and found herself being dragged bodily back into the room.

facts.event: 两人都不敢看墙上挂毯：上面绣着天鹅王的妻子与女儿共四个女人，一个远在流放地，两个已死，Elise 是最小也是最后一个。
facts.relation: Elise 是国王最小的女儿，亡姐 Isuire 的妹妹；母亲 Isabella 已死
facts.anchor: four women, the wife and daughters of the swan king. One in distant exile, two dead.

facts.event: Isen 告诉 Elise，父亲（国王）派人召见她，她必须立刻前往。
facts.relation: Isen 替父亲传召妹妹；国王是他们的父亲
facts.anchor: Why do you think I’m here in the women’s apartments, Elise?’ said Isen. ‘He sent for you.’
